name: Linear Mixed Model Experiment (Synthetic, Abstract)
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing a linear mixed model with fixed and random effects. Supports R-style formula notation (e.g., 'y ~ x1 + (1|group)') for specifying random intercepts, random slopes, and multiple grouping variables.

lmm_experiment.name: formula
lmm_experiment.description: Model specification using R-style notation (e.g., 'y ~ x1 + (1|group)').

lmm_experiment.name: fixed_effects
lmm_experiment.description: Dictionary mapping effect names to coefficients.

lmm_experiment.name: random_effects
lmm_experiment.description: Nested dictionary specifying random intercepts/slopes as standard deviations.

lmm_experiment.name: random_state
lmm_experiment.description: Seed for random number generator to ensure reproducibility.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Experimental conditions specifying independent variable values.

outputDataType.name: observations
